notes: Adventure, Scavenger Hunt — the prompt names the collection games it is modelled on, and the loop is finding scattered targets and logging them rather than fighting or levelling. Shape is world-open: the author scoped this build to the Costa Rica jungle as one small short-pass habitat, so it is a single contiguous map searched in any order and stays P0. collectible-nodes carries the bird species themselves, placed as findable perched creatures at different rarities rather than a wandering ambient population, alcove-secret gives the rare toucans, macaws and quetzals real places to be tucked away in the canopy and undergrowth, tracker-quest is the Bird Journal made physical so the habitat milestone is visible in the world, and landmark-focal answers the author's ask for readable jungle landmarks to navigate by. Decided without a user: the later habitats are genuinely separate maps and would route P4, which is not ready and is outside this build anyway, so they are deferred and only the first jungle is built; the run has no terminal end because the author confirmed collection is ongoing, so no exit or win zone is placed.
